blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
If a change should update the screen. For example:

items: Displaying a live character count below a text input
Toggling a dropdown open or closed
Showing or hiding an error message after form validation
Updating a list of items when the user adds or removes one

blocks.content: If you just need to remember a value or access a DOM element without affecting the render. For example:

items: Focusing an input field on page load
Storing a timer ID so you can clear it later
Keeping track of a previous scroll position
Holding a reference to a third-party library instance (like a chart or map)

blocks.content: Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
